title: Half-byte retention across sliced base16 stream writes
summary: A public decoding stream receives one backing byte array at its actual changing offsets. Closing it yields the mathematically decoded bytes.

change.description: A public decoding stream receives one backing byte array at its actual changing offsets. Closing it yields the mathematically decoded bytes.

notes: The frozen independent observation table has 2051 rows. Each property identifies its own input range. The subject JDK is Temurin 21.0.13.

Decoding 4142434445 with writes at offsets 0, 3 and 7 yielded ABCD on the parent and ABCDE on the fix. A single write and a 2+4+4 schedule yielded ABCDE on both. The public stream receives the same source array for every write.
The same style of a stateful public caller and independent end observation transfers from the Gson reader. This case additionally needed the selected JDK output-stream and byte-array growth bytecode.
